business.summary: L&T operates across engineering, procurement, construction, manufacturing, and services, spanning Infrastructure & Utilities, Energy (Conventional and Green), Manufacturing & Products, and Services. The company is actively pursuing international and domestic opportunities while targeting multi-year growth under its Lakshya strategic plans.

promises.promise: Achieving full year FY26 revenue growth guidance of 15%
promises.delivered: FY26 quarterly sales grew +16% (Jun 2025), +10% (Sep 2025), +10% (Dec 2025), and +11% (Mar 2026 to Rs 82,762 crore). Q4 FY26 concall confirmed revenue growth was impacted by subdued execution in domestic projects and missed full-year guidance.

promises.promise: Exceeding the 10% order inflow guidance for FY26
promises.delivered: Q4 FY26 concall confirmed the company significantly surpassed this guidance driven by strong order wins across multiple sectors.

promises.promise: Close FY26 with a revised Net Working Capital to Revenue target of around 10%
promises.delivered: Q4 FY26 concall reported that Net Working Capital to Revenue improved sharply to 4.1% as of March 2026.

promises.promise: Group order inflows to grow in the range of 10% to 12% in FY27
promises.delivered: Q1 FY27 order inflows grew 14% YoY to Rs 1,080 billion and Q2 FY27 reported highest ever quarterly order inflow; full FY27 delivery pending.

promises.promise: FY27 revenue growth to be in the range of 10% to 12%
promises.delivered: Sales grew +7% YoY in Jun 2026 (Rs 67,942 crore) and +16% YoY in Sep 2026 (Rs 78,750 crore); full FY27 results pending.

promises.promise: FY27 Net Working Capital to Revenue of around 10%
promises.delivered: Q1 FY27 concall stated NWC to Sales ratio was 4.9% in June 2026; full year FY27 delivery pending.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: The group revenues grew 10% Y-on-Y in Q3 FY26.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Dec 2025 Sales stood at Rs 71,450 crore compared to Rs 64,668 crore in Dec 2024, reflecting exact YoY Sales growth of +10%.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Group revenues for Q1 FY27 stood at Rs. 679 billion, registering a 7% Y-on-Y growth.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Jun 2026 Sales were Rs 67,942 crore vs Rs 63,679 crore in Jun 2025, matching +7% YoY growth.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Our Recurring PAT at Rs 44 billion reported a strong growth of 31% Y-on-Y in Q3 FY26.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Table reports consolidated Net Profit for Dec 2025 at Rs 3,825 crore, which is down YoY from Rs 3,974 crore in Dec 2024.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Revenue growth was impacted by subdued execution in certain domestic projects in Q4 FY26.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Mar 2026 YoY Sales growth came in at +11% (Sales Rs 82,762 crore vs Rs 74,392 crore in Mar 2025), below the earlier full-year 15% expectation.

guidance.guide: 13% to 15% revenue CAGR growth over five years under Lakshya L31 with EBIT margins of 16% to 17%

bull: Sales rebounded strongly in Sep 2026 to Rs 78,750 crore (+16% YoY) with Net Profit expanding to Rs 5,949 crore.
Order inflow momentum is sustained with Q1 FY27 growing 14% YoY to Rs 1,080 billion and Q2 FY27 logging highest ever order inflows via Mega and Ultra Mega orders in Energy - Conventional.
Working capital management remains strong, with NWC to sales at 4.9% in June 2026 and 4.1% in March 2026, well superior to the ~10% targeted range.
bear: Operating Profit Margin (OPM) compressed to 11% in Sep 2026 from 13% in Sep 2025 and 12% in Jun 2026.
Execution vulnerability remains in domestic projects (such as Water and Effluent Treatment) and clearance delays, which previously caused FY26 revenue to fall short of its 15% target.
High quarterly interest burden persists consistently above Rs 2,400 crore, reaching Rs 2,571 crore in Jun 2026 and Rs 2,442 crore in Sep 2026.
